channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Gas prices in Vermont have dropped slightly to four dollars thirty-four cents a gallon. Prices are lowest in Bennington and Addison counties and highest near the I-eighty-nine corridor. Diesel prices, however, have risen nationally, keeping fuel costs high for many drivers.

An archaeological dig at the Bennington Battle Monument uncovered what may be a historic tavern. Artifacts include a King George the Third coin and mason-marked pipe pieces. The site will be open to visitors through tomorrow before preservation work begins.

One million dollars in funding is now available to dairy farmers in the Northeast. Farmers in New York, Vermont, and New Hampshire can apply for modernization grants. This program covers eleven states to support farm improvements.

The Adirondack region is alive with Halloween events this week. From plays and poetry readings to parades and trunk-or-treats, towns like Tupper Lake, Lake Placid, and Schroon Lake are hosting family-friendly festivities. These activities celebrate community spirit and the spooky season across the North Country.
